reviewer: Codex evidence audit (not a second DeepSeek run)
overall: Tool-routing and execution acceptance passes. Generated prose has one incorrect abbreviated input-hash suffix and an overbroad FDR sentence; consult this audit and machine provenance rather than treating model prose as authoritative scientific evidence.

checks.evidence_or_correction: Seven successful tool calls contain exactly SWA, COCO, eCOCO in that order, once each. All run status fields are completed; remote conclusions success.

checks.evidence_or_correction: All three table run IDs, Actions run IDs, status values and null parent_run_id values match immutable archived result records.

checks.claim: SWA method lomb, coordinate_unit m, fmax 16.590563165905568
checks.evidence_or_correction: Matches SWA effective_parameters; fmax is spatial frequency per metre, not a temporal frequency.

checks.claim: SWA input_rows 439, removed_nonfinite_rows 0, processed_rows 439, interpolated false; 440 structural lines include the header
checks.evidence_or_correction: Matches MATLAB summary, CSV header, and inspector line_count. The model correctly distinguishes structural lines from numeric samples.

checks.claim: SWA 218 frequency bins; peaks above pointwise 95% at 0.821 m, 4.38 m, 0.411 m, 0.286 m
checks.evidence_or_correction: Matches the rounded spatial periods and above_pointwise_95 flags in the SWA summary. These are spatial wavelengths in metres; no time conversion was claimed.

checks.claim: No global test result exists here ... no FDR-confirmed peak at any of the five levels
checks.evidence_or_correction: The historical adapter returns all fdr_threshold_available=false and above_fdr_5=null. This supports only absence of an interpretable separately returned threshold in this tool result. It does not establish that the original SWA algorithm performed no FDR calculation or that a correctly interpreted FDR procedure had zero discoveries. Preferred wording: This archived adapter response cannot support an FDR discovery claim.

checks.claim: COCO input_rows 2344, all finite, 0 duplicates collapsed, no interpolation
checks.evidence_or_correction: Matches MATLAB preparation originalRowCount, finiteRowCount, duplicateRowsCollapsed and interpolationApplied.

checks.claim: Target at 210 Ma (rounded), 9 periods 405.69 to 17.68 kyr; grid 8 to 16 cm/kyr, 9 rates; nsim 19, seed 1
checks.evidence_or_correction: Matches target_age_rounded_ma, orbital_periods_kyr, rate_count, rate_unit, effective_parameters and summary. No depth/time/rate unit mismatch found.

checks.claim: No rate passes global p < 0.05; best exploratory rate 8 cm/kyr, correlation 0.364, minimum_rate_global_p 0.95, Wilson CI [0.7536, 0.9906]
checks.evidence_or_correction: Matches COCO summary and rounding. The interval refers to the Monte Carlo p estimate, not to sedimentation-rate uncertainty.

checks.claim: Best rate uses only 7/9 distinct resolved periods; does not address the complete nine-period target
checks.evidence_or_correction: Matches the upstream interpretation qualification.

checks.claim: eCOCO same 2344 input rows; window 500 m / step 500 m, no padding; 3 windows centred at 250/750/1250 m
checks.evidence_or_correction: Matches eCOCO summary exactly. Windows are defined by the upstream method; the model did not invent an extra edge window.

checks.claim: Tracked rates [11,11,11] cm/kyr; 27 finite cells, 0 unresolved; nsim_completed 19; nfft 1024 vs COCO 4096
checks.evidence_or_correction: Matches eCOCO summary and both effective-parameter records. The differing nfft is explicitly disclosed.

checks.claim: Descriptive ridge, no correction across windows; map_global_applied false
checks.evidence_or_correction: Matches rate_global_p_scope and map_global_applied. The model correctly avoids a map-wide significance claim.
